{
  "name": "linear-workflow",
  "displayName": "Linear Workflow",
  "version": "0.1.3",
  "description": "Linear workflow for Claude Code: issue-next, issue-start, issue-review, issue-ship and issue-plan-cycle skills backed by a deterministic CLI, a linear-manager agent, and a mod that shows the current issue above the prompt with your other sessions and conflict warnings",
  "author": {
    "name": "Olivier Depiesse",
    "url": "https://github.com/Sarimarcus"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Sarimarcus/claude-code-plugins/tree/main/plugins/linear-workflow",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Sarimarcus/claude-code-plugins",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "linear",
    "workflow",
    "issue",
    "pull-request",
    "git",
    "mod",
    "agent"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "linearApiKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Linear API key",
      "description": "Personal API key (Linear → Settings → Security & access). Left empty, the LINEAR_API_KEY environment variable is used, then LINEAR_API_KEY in <repo>/.env.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    },
    "teamKeys": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Team keys",
      "description": "Comma-separated Linear team keys to look for in branch names (e.g. ENG, OPS), used in repos whose .claude/linear.json sets no teamKey. Left empty: the keys of the teams you belong to.",
      "default": "",
      "required": false
    },
    "registryFile": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sub-project registry",
      "description": "Optional JSON file at the repo root listing sub-projects ({\"projects\":[{\"key\",\"path\"}]}). When set, issue labels that match a key define the issue's scope, and edits outside it raise a drift toast. Empty: off.",
      "default": "",
      "required": false
    },
    "pinCommand": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pin command",
      "description": "Slash command (without /) whose first argument is an issue id; running it pins that issue to the session. Defaults to the bundled /issue-start. Empty disables.",
      "default": "issue-start",
      "required": false
    },
    "pollMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Refresh interval (minutes)",
      "description": "How often the issue is re-fetched from Linear.",
      "default": 5,
      "required": false
    },
    "showOtherSessions": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show other sessions",
      "description": "Share this session's issue with your other local Claude Code sessions (via ~/.claude/linear-workflow/sessions) and list theirs in the band.",
      "default": true,
      "required": false
    }
  }
}
files.types/index.d.ts:
export type IssueChild = { identifier: string; title: string; state: string; stateType: string }

export type IssueComment = { author: string; createdAt: string; body: string }

export type Issue = {
  identifier: string
  title: string
  url: string
  state: string
  stateType: string
  priority: string
  labels: string[]
  parent: { identifier: string; title: string; labels: string[] } | null
  assignee: string | null
  cycle: number | null
  milestone: string | null
  description: string
  children: IssueChild[]
  comments: IssueComment[]
  links: { title: string; url: string }[]
}

export type IssueSource = { id: string; from: 'root' | 'sites' | 'pinned'; detail: string }

export type SessionEntry = {
  sessionId: string
  checkout: string
  label: string
  issue: string | null
  title: string | null
  state: string | null
  stateType: string | null
  /** Pinned, or on a branch this session switched to itself. */
  claimed: boolean
  updatedAt: number
}

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'linear-workflow': {
      issue: Issue | null
      source: IssueSource | null
      error: string | null
      isBandHidden: boolean
      pinned: string | null
      pinnedBy: 'command' | 'manual' | 'held' | null
      warned: string[]
      others: SessionEntry[]
      conflictsWarned: string[]
      claimedBranch: string | null
    }
  }
}
